en: Maybe yer taste buds are messed up.
That's not true at all!
But if it makes it tastes good to me, maybe I'm better off that way.
Yeah, maybe.
I just like beef and pork better. Lamb barbecue places only serve lamb. I like to be able to get tripe and other stuff.
Why not try going to a regular yakiniku restaurant instead of a specialty place then?
Whoa, you can get lamb at yakiniku places here?
Maybe not everywhere, but at most of them.
That's good. Bein' able to have tripe at the same time as lamb must be enjoyable.
Right? Hokkaido's got a lot to be proud of when it comes to our food offerings!
I had no idea. In Tokyo ya can only get lamb barbecue at specialty restaurants.
I wish more people would eat it.
A barbecue at your university? I didn't know ya could do that sorta thing at school.
Sure, people do it all the time. There are special trash cans for it and everything.
Hm. I heard folks were free to do what they wanted at college, but I didn't know ya could even have barbecues.
Do you ever barbecue, Saejima-san?
Yeah, I like campin'. I go all the time.
I figured you were an outdoorsy sort! Are you any good at cooking?
I'm good at startin' fires. I can get a fire goin' on a snow-capped mountain with no lighter.
That's amazing! Let's have a barbecue together next time!
Okay. Make sure ya bring good meat.
I'm better at eatin'. I mostly just wait and let the meat sit over the fire.
Still, if you're a big eater, it's more fun for whoever's doing the cooking.
Yeah, I just keep on stuffin' my face.
I prefer eatin' in restaurants. Gatherin' ingredients and cookin' 'em is a big hassle.
Aww, you don't think it's fun?
I spent a long time havin' my meals served to me at a set time every day. I can't get used to preppin' it all by myself.
Do you make your wife do all the work, Saejima-san? You can't always have it your way.
Nah, I haven't exactly been married...
Were you cold outside?
It was freezin'. Is it this cold all the time?
Yes. Today isn't really colder than normal.
I'm fine. It's colder up in the mountains. Here in Tsukimino, my normal clothes are enough.
Wow, you're quite the tough guy, Saejima-san.
I can't handle the cold myself.
No? Shouldn't ya be used to it if yer from around here?
I don't get outside much. I'm kind of a shut-in actually. Most of the time I hang around the house.
I get ya. I don't like goin' outside in the cold either.
Right? Come winter, I make it a point to hole up inside and never go out!
I'm jealous. I used to hafta go outside, come rain or snow.
Hey, maybe you could hibernate like me! Then you can come out to work in the spring!
That'd be nice. We Japanese work too much as it is. We deserve to be able to take the winter off.
Right. And since you'd get sunburned in the summer, we can just work in spring and fall.
That's maybe takin' a bit too much time off...
Ya'd get fat without exercise. I've gotten all sluggish from spendin' too much time indoors.
I know that! I'll make sure to go outside once the snow has melted.
Besides, going out in the cold is bad for you. There are lots of people out there with colds.
Hm. I guess ya've got a point.
How do ya live like that? You can't get much done if ya don't get outta the house.
Well, I do most of my shopping online. Buying a bunch of groceries at once is cheaper anyway. It's surprisingly economical!
So ya eat the same stuff every day?
Yeah, so I go out of my way to change up the seasonings a bit each day, so that I don't get sick of anything.
That's a strange way to focus yer efforts.
But yer out right now. Yer here workin'. How's that make ya a shut-in?
Oh, I live in the building right next door.
I can walk to work in one minute. It's nice! Plus, the club handles my rent for me.
The ideal workplace.
Yeah, but if I ever quit, I'll have to move out. It kinda makes it harder for me to change jobs.
Just how much do ya stay at home anyways? Ya seem more cooped up than a prisoner.
Sounds like a hassle to me. With you bein' so close, if they're ever short-staffed, they're always gonna call ya.
Yeah! The other day it was all cold and snowy, so I called and said I couldn't get to work since the trains were stopped. But they didn't buy it...
Well, ya are a minute's walk away...
What are ya, a cat? Yer still young, stop whinin' and go outside.
Oh, I have a cat! He's always lounging around the house.
I like cats. I wanna get one for myself.
Ooh, you like cats too, Saejima-san? I never would have guessed!
What I really like are tigers. But since you can't have one of those as a pet, I gotta go with a cat instead.
Ahaha! A tiger, huh? Well, given how big they are, I bet they'd be super warm.
It'll get fat if ya never let it out. And chubby cats ain't cute at all.
That's not true! I think both cats and people look perfectly cute with a little bit of plumpness to them!
Why are ya praisin' yourself so casual-like?
Was it that obvious?
Gimme a break...
Just like its owner... Do ya ever let yer cat outside?
Never. I always keep all my windows closed. It gets too cold if I leave them open.
But doesn't the cat ever wanna get out a bit?
No, not at all! He definitely likes to stay inside.
This morning, the TV said that Scorpios would have the best of luck today!
Lucky you. What'd they say?
They said today would be lucky for money! So I've got high hopes!
Want me to buy some drinks?
Do you really mean it?
Sure. I like to work hard and play hard. Might as well have some fun today.
I knew I could count on you, Saejima-san! You're so generous!
Service, please!
I can't afford it. Sorry. Maybe next time.
Okaaay...
Just kiddin'. I see right through yer attempt at beggin'. I wasn't born yesterday, y'know.
Awww! Can't you just play along?
Can't help ya.
Oh, why do you have to be such a wet blanket when I'm making an effort here?
It's yer job to make the effort.
Are they ever right? Don't different shows all say different things?
Please, let me dream a little. I've been keeping my eyes peeled all day in case I find money that's been dropped on the ground.
Maybe ya will. If ya didn't have the crazy idea to be lookin' for it, it might actually be there and ya'd never even notice.
Exactly. It's important to strive towards your goals.
Ya dummy. If you could get money that easily, everyone would be rich.
That's why I'm only doing it for today.
That's basically just stealin' though. If ya do find money, you should take it to the cops.
So you believe in astrology, huh? Ya seem to be pretty happy-go-lucky, so I didn't expect it.
I don't really believe in it, exactly. I just think it's fun to watch it every day. Kind of like if it were baseball or soccer.
It would be like, "Get out there and go for it, Scorpios!" or, "Might wanna rein it in a bit there, Geminis."
That's fun. And just like baseball, there's twelve teams to follow.
Yeah, see? You should root for your team too, Saejima-san!
I wonder if it'd work.
What's the point? I bet they just cycle through the same things every day.
But that's what luck's like. You can't do anything if you're on a bad streak. It's smart living to put effort in only at the right times.
Sounds like an excuse for bein' a slacker.
You should go all in then. What did it say about yer luck with romance?
Well... They did say I may have a chance encounter with a real dreamy guy!
I wonder if they meant you, Saejima-san!
Who knows?
But I guess I didn't. That guy would have bought an expensive bottle of liquor. Hint hint...
I said I'd buy one next time. Geez.
Hm. Good luck with that.
You know, lots of people tell me I'm a pretty easygoing person.
Ya do seem pretty laid back most times.
Are you the more impatient type, Saejima-san?
Yeah. We Kansai folk are all pretty impatient. We dunno how to just sit and wait.
I get that impression, yes. I'll be talking to someone and they'll be all, "What's your point?" before I'm even done with what I'm saying.
Yeah, sounds 'bout right. We're not good with drawn-out, ramblin' conversations.
Nah, I'm the kinda guy who can wait things out when I wanna.
Yeah, you strike me as someone who does his own thing, regardless of what other people want.
Ya can't let yerself get caught up in what other folks want. I go at my own pace.
So yeah, the other day a friend of mine sent me an email. When I didn't respond right away she got all mad, demanding I get back to her.
It's not like she called me on the phone, so it isn't like I needed to reply right away, right? Am I weird for thinking that?
Nah, it's up to you. Just 'cause ya got mail, it don't mean ya gotta respond.
I agree! If she wanted a prompt reply she should have said so in the email. But if she had, I probably would have ignored it.
You should respond right away. The other person might need ya to.
But all she wanted to know was if I was free. And it's not like me being free means I want to hang out. I was thinking about when I wanted to do other stuff.
So ya had yer own stuff to worry about, then.
But didn't you just say you can't let yourself get caught up in what other people want?
That's different. Ya gotta just go with the flow sometimes.
How long did ya put it off, anyway?
Um... Around three weeks?
That's it? If she got mad at ya over that, she must be pretty impatient.
Seriously. I check my email when I have time. I don't need someone to tell me when to read my messages.
We have plenty of opportunities to hang out, so I don't get what the big rush was all about.
Well, ya never know when it might be the last. Ya need to value your time with yer friends.
Yeah, that was too long. Goin' that long without respondin', she mighta started wonderin' if you were dead or somethin'.
Then how long can I wait before responding?
Hm... Maybe three minutes or so?
What? That's waaay too short! How impatient a guy are you, Saejima-san?
I'm not talkin' about me. My partner says he wants an answer in three minutes.
Hm... Maybe three days or so?
I guess I could probably manage that.
If you email me, ya probably shouldn't expect a response for three days.
Ya probably just forgot. Did ya not even remember it until she bugged ya for a reply?
Hahaha! You got me there.
Go figure. Yer not easygoing, then. Just forgetful.
Hey, I've got something to tell you real quick!
One of the girls here who I'm good friends with is going to be working at a cabaret club!
Right? Do you really get what I'm saying?
Huh? What're ya talkin' about? Doesn't she already work here?
I said at a cabaret club.
Here in Tsukimino, "cabaret club" is what we call the sexy kind.
And by the sexy kind, you mean...
It's like... A club where girls take their tops off and you're allowed to touch.
You can touch!?
Not here you can't! Geez, Saejima-san, stop being such a pervert.
I had no idea. That's different from Tokyo.
Yeah. That's why the barkers have to watch out, to make sure customers know what kind of place they're being taken to.
Then this place ain't a cabaret club?
This is what's called a "new club."
New club? Don't know that one.
So, what do you think about this girl?
Good for her. She can do what she wants.
Wow, you think so?
Why, are ya worried?
I'd be worried.
Me too! I told her she'd be better off not doing it, but...
Lots of girls say they're just going to work cabaret clubs, but before they know it, they're working the sex trade.
I see. If she thinks she can handle it, then I don't see the problem. But if she's just out to make some quick, easy money, that's no good.
You're very nice towards women, y'know? I was wondering what I'd do if you supported it.
It's a line a' work, and there's a need for it. If she takes the job, she might be able to save someone. Just make sure she's tough enough.
Okay, I'll give her a call later. I hope she's willing to change her mind.
What's wrong with that? Ya may think that way 'cause yer a woman, but as a man, I can appreciate it.
If I wasn't close to her I wouldn't really care, but we were friends enough to hang out regularly.
Whatever she decides to do, she's not gonna stop bein' herself. If yer her friend, ya oughta support her.
But not you?
Not me. I would never.
I make enough money here at the new club. It's weird for me to say this, but here appearance is what matters most.
If you're pretty, you can get customers without having to strip for them, and you can have a nice time simply by talking.
